    • getInfixSymbol

      types - The type checking result of the expression that contains the node.

    • getInfixOperator

      @Nullable public static IOperator getInfixOperator(String symbol, @Nullable IValueType<?> leftType, @Nullable IValueType<?> rightType)
      Parameters:
      symbol - A symbol.
      leftType - The type of the first input, or null if unknown.
      rightType - The type of the second input, or null if unknown.
      Returns:
      The operator written with this symbol between inputs of these types, see choose(java.util.List<org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.api.evaluate.operator.IOperator>, java.util.List<org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.api.evaluate.variable.IValueType<?>>, boolean), or null. So + is concat if one of the inputs is a string, and addition otherwise.

    • isMethodCall

      public static boolean isMethodCall(ExpressionNode.Operator node, int[] path, ExpressionTypeChecker.Result types)
      Calls are written as a method of their first argument, as in item.size(), when they use the scoped name, as the type of that argument tells which operator it is. Operators that take an operator first, such as map(f, l), and choices stay calls, and so do calls on an empty slot or a number, which reads as a decimal point, as in 1.max(2).
      Parameters:
      node - An operator node.
      path - The path of the node.
      types - The type checking result of the expression that contains the node.
      Returns:
      If the node is written as a method of its first argument.

    • resolve

      @Nullable public static IOperator resolve(String name, @Nullable List<IValueType<?>> argumentTypes)
      Find the operator with the given name, as written by getName(org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.api.evaluate.operator.IOperator, java.util.List<org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.api.evaluate.variable.IValueType<?>>). Global names always match exactly, and scoped names that several operators share are chosen between by choose(java.util.List<org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.api.evaluate.operator.IOperator>, java.util.List<org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.api.evaluate.variable.IValueType<?>>, boolean).
      Parameters:
      name - A global or scoped name.
      argumentTypes - The types of all arguments, null where unknown, or null for an operator used as a value.
      Returns:
      The operator, or null if the name is unknown.
